sources.title: Lair @ Nyu | Creo
sources.snippet: The Lab for Autonomous and Intelligent Robotics (LAIR) is a university research lab at NYU that strives to develop new robotics algorithms, ML models, and control systems motivated by in-the-wild applications. Originally focussing on multi-robot systems and motion planning, the lab's work has been applied to marine biology, archaeology, autonomous driving, security systems, and oceanography ...
